title: report.py service-providers --output-mode json
description: One table of every stored service provider (template publisher; GitHub issue #211), including one without templates, at most --limit rows. Support counts are current state; reach describes the selected import, named in the note.

rows.description: Ordered by reach_domains (descending) when a domain share is selected, otherwise by supported_templates descending; ties by name, case-insensitively. Empty when there are none.

name.description: Service provider name, falling back to its id.

service_provider_id.description: Service provider id (Domain Connect providerId of the template publisher).

templates.description: Stored templates (service ids, every version together); 0 for a service provider without any.

supported_templates.description: Templates at least one DNS provider supports (any version; report.py service-templates' supported_count > 0).

supporting_dns_providers.description: DNS providers supporting at least one of its templates, each counted once.

first_added_at.description: Earliest created_at of its stored templates; null without templates or when unknown.

last_updated_at.description: Latest updated_at of its stored templates; null without templates or when unknown.

reach_domains.description: Domains behind the supporting_dns_providers, in the selected import (each provider counted once, so at most the sum of its templates' reach); null without a domain share.

reach_pct.description: reach_domains as a percentage of the import's scanned domains.
